parts.label: (a)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
Carry out a relevant method to find $A,B$ such that $\dfrac2{1-9y^2}=\dfrac A{1+3y}+\dfrac B{1-3y}$ - M1, OE. Allow M1 for finding $A,B$ in the form $A/(1+3y)+B/(3y-1)$ and A1 for $A=1,B=-1$ if $-2=A(3y-1)+B(1+3y)$, but A0 for $A=-1,B=1$ if $2=A(3y-1)+B(1+3y)$.

Obtain $A=1,B=1$ - A1. If working with $x$ and never $y$, award M1A0, but allow M1A1 if $y$ appears anywhere on the RHS.

Printed total: 2.

parts.label: (b)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
Separate variables correctly and attempt integration of at least one side - M1. Integrate to obtain at least one log term $p\ln(a+by)$, or $q\ln((a+by)/(a-by))$, or a tangent term on the other side; disregard the factor 2 if present.

Integrate $2/(1-9y^2)$ to obtain $\frac13\ln(1+3y)-\frac13\ln(1-3y)$ - A1FT, or $\frac13\ln((1+3y)/(1-3y))$. FT from their partial fractions: $A/3\ln(1+3y)-B/3\ln(1-3y)$, or $A/3\ln(1+3y)+B/3\ln(3y-1)$; the factor 2 must be dealt with correctly.

Obtain $r\tan3x$ - B1.

Obtain term $\frac13\tan3x$ - B1; allow $\frac16\tan3x$ if factor 2 was not dealt with earlier.

Use $y=0$ when $x=\pi/12$ to evaluate a constant, or as limits, in a solution $p\ln(1+3y)+q\ln(1-3y)+r\tan3x$, $p,q,r\ne0$ - M1. Guidance: $0+0+1/3+C=0$; no substitution errors.

Obtain $\frac13\ln(1+3y)-\frac13\ln(1-3y)=\frac13\tan3x-\frac13$ - A1, OE, ISW; then $y=\frac13-\frac{2}{3(1+e^{\tan3x-1})}$ or $y=\frac{e^{\tan3x-1}-1}{3(e^{\tan3x-1}+1)}$.

Printed total: 6.
